name: iCloud Mail (Rui)
description: Search, read, and organize messages through iCloud Mail IMAP/SMTP, and create drafts or send mail. Cindy stores the app-specific password securely and provides it to the plugin Worker only while handling a mail request.
whenToUse: Use when the user needs to find, read, or organize iCloud Mail messages, create a draft, or send mail. Before first use, enter the iCloud Mail address and Apple Account app-specific password in the plugin details and complete the connection test.
author: Rui Valim

secretBindings.label: Apple Account app-specific password A
secretBindings.hint: An app-specific password generated on the Apple Account website, not your Apple Account password

secretBindings.label: Apple Account app-specific password B
secretBindings.hint: An app-specific password generated on the Apple Account website, not your Apple Account password

tools.name: icloud_mail_status
tools.description: Check whether iCloud Mail is configured. Returns only the email address and connection status, never the app-specific password.

tools.name: icloud_mail
tools.description: Perform iCloud Mail operations: list folders, search, read, send, save drafts, mark messages read or unread, and move messages. Each operation opens a temporary IMAP/SMTP connection and closes it afterward. Sending, moving, and changing read status require explicit user intent.

folder.description: Raw IMAP folder name, defaults to INBOX. For anything other than INBOX, call list_folders first and use the path returned by the server verbatim; do not translate it.

message_uid.description: Message UID. A UID is only valid within its folder and must be used together with the folder returned by search.

target_folder.description: Raw path of the destination folder for move; get it from list_folders first.

to.description: For search, a recipient keyword; for send/draft, the recipient addresses as a comma-separated string or an array of strings.

cc.description: Cc addresses for send/draft, as a comma-separated string or an array of strings.

bcc.description: Bcc addresses for send/draft, as a comma-separated string or an array of strings.

subject.description: For search, a subject keyword; for send/draft, the message subject.

unread.description: For search, true returns only unread messages and false only read ones; omit for no filter.

since.description: Search start date, as an ISO date or date-time.

before.description: Search end date, as an ISO date or date-time.

max_results.description: Number of search results to return, default 10, max 20.
